name: A New Plague
summary: In Brill, Apothecary Johaan gathers blood from darkhounds for a new plague. The Royal Apothecary Society works at Lady Sylvanas Windrunner’s command.

sections.title: A Royal Mandate
sections.body:
Apothecary Johaan serves the Royal Apothecary Society in Brill, under orders from the Dark Lady. Sylvanas Windrunner has charged her alchemists with making a disease unlike any Azeroth has known.

The Lich King's Plague of Undeath slaughtered humanity and bound their souls. This new plague is meant to annihilate Arthas Menethil and lay waste to his Scourge legions.

sections.title: Raw Ingredients
sections.body:
Johaan seeks grim experiments for a weapon against the undead. He believes the blood of native beasts may hold useful chemical properties, and begins with darkhounds roaming Tirisfal Glades.

You gather vials of their tainted blood. Johaan can isolate its elements and test whether the beasts' resilience and predatory nature might help make a lethal contagion.

faq.q: What is the goal of the new plague?
faq.answer: Lady Sylvanas tasked the Royal Apothecary Society with brewing a disease deadlier than any other on Azeroth. It is meant to destroy Arthas and his Scourge army.
Johaan serves the Royal Apothecary Society in Brill. He conducts early field experiments with compounds gathered from Tirisfal's local beasts.

faq.q: Why does Johaan need darkhound blood?
faq.answer: Johaan believes native beasts' blood may provide a foundation for his alchemical formulas. He needs darkhound blood to test his early theories in the laboratory.

faq.q: How does this plague differ from the Scourge's plague?
faq.answer: The Lich King's Plague of Undeath was made to slaughter the living and bind their souls. Sylvanas's new plague is meant to bring ruin to Arthas's undead legions.

faq.q: Who ordered the creation of this plague?
faq.answer: Lady Sylvanas Windrunner directly ordered the Royal Apothecary Society to create the plague. She believes Forsaken alchemy combined with newfound magic can defeat Arthas.

faq.q: What happens after gathering the blood?
faq.answer: Gathering darkhound blood begins a series of experiments. Johaan uses the samples to refine the pathogen through further field tests across the Glades.

angles.text: As an undead, you make your first direct contribution to the Royal Apothecary Society's project: creating the weapon Sylvanas plans to wield against Arthas.
As a member of the Horde, you stand beside the Forsaken. Their alchemical work in Tirisfal centers on a grim weapon aimed at Northrend.
